name: The Binding
summary: Stormwind warlocks seek to bind a succubus to their will. Beneath The Slaughtered Lamb, an initiate uses the enchanted core from the Heartswood to summon the demon and defeat it in combat.

sections.title: Descent into the Crypt
sections.body: A crypt beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter shelters the city's warlocks. There, away from the city watch and the Cathedral of Light, they practice forbidden arts. Stone summoning circles channel the Nether's power and let initiates reach across the veil between worlds.

sections.title: Subjugating the Seductress
sections.body: A warlock needs the prepared Heartswood Core to summon a succubus. The ritual opens a breach at the summoning circle, but the demon can corrupt and overwhelm even a fortified mind. To master it, the warlock must defeat it in single combat. Its physical form returns to the Twisting Nether, while its true tether is secured.

sections.title: Gakin's Secrets
sections.body: After slaying the summoned creature, the initiate takes the depleted core back to Gakin the Darkbinder. Gakin then teaches the knowledge needed to call the succubus across the void. The rite marks an Alliance warlock's growth into an adept trusted to handle volatile, sapient demons.

faq.q: Where does the summoning take place?
faq.answer: The summoning takes place in the catacombs beneath The Slaughtered Lamb, a tavern in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Spiral stairs lead past the pub cellar to an underground sanctum with arcane summoning circles.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Heartswood Core?
faq.answer: The Heartswood Core anchors and fuels the summoning. Taken from the Heartswood, a tree that grew where two night elf lovers fell in Ashenvale during the War of the Ancients, it carries the spiritual resonance needed to open a rift and draw a succubus across the Twisting Nether.

faq.q: Why must the warlock kill the succubus?
aliases: why do i fight the succubus
why kill the demon to bind it
faq.answer: A warlock must slay the succubus to establish dominance over it. Succubi use manipulation and mental subjugation, and allowing one to manifest without defeating it invites ruin. Combat imprints the warlock's authority on the spirit before it coalesces back in the Nether.

Gakin the Darkbinder is a senior warlock who lives in The Slaughtered Lamb and oversees Alliance practitioners' training in Stormwind. He arranges the secret procurement of demonology artifacts and judges whether acolytes have the will to command demons.

faq.q: Who is Surena that Gakin mentions?
faq.answer: Surena Caledon was Gakin's former student. She ran off with the Defias, and you recovered her choker earlier. Gakin wonders wryly if she was a succubus in disguise sent to warp his mind, then decides he gives her too much credit.

faq.q: Are succubi permitted in the streets of Stormwind?
aliases: is demon summoning legal in stormwind
faq.answer: The Church of the Holy Light and the kingdom's authorities strictly forbid open demonology. Bound demons may follow warlocks through the city, but in lore the practice stays in shadows, basements, and secluded sanctums such as The Slaughtered Lamb's crypts.

angles.text: As a human or gnome warlock, this rite marks a step from handling mindless imps and voidwalkers to commanding sapient, calculating demons.
As an Alliance member, you can see how Stormwind quietly tolerates shadow magic in hidden alcoves despite the Church's doctrines.
